title: Generalized generator values for pullback tensor transitions
statement: For a normalized ringed coefficient diagram, the tensor comparison followed by any pair of semilinear transitions carries an arbitrary generalized homogeneous tensor section to the homogeneous tensor of the two transitioned inverse-image generators. The first coefficient is transported by the coefficient-ring map; the second is one. The generalized tensor input is explicitly required to be the pairing of its two factors in that bidegree; no lifting of arbitrary local sheaf sections is assumed.

source.place: Steps 6 and 7 of lem-pur-coefficient-comparisons-strict-totalization; Stacks 03EK, 03EL, 07A4, proof constituents.

proof.text: Write the generalized tensor section as the pure pairing followed by its coproduct inclusion. Pullback-generator naturality and the module comparison pure formula take it to the pairing of the two inverse-image generators in the same summand. The normalized scalar tensor comparison carries its scalar on the first factor and inserts one in the second. Kappa normalization and naturality apply the two arbitrary semilinear transitions. Scalar linearity transports the first coefficient through the ring morphism.

proof_origin.place: Steps 6 and 7 of the original signed totalization argument.
